title: Fork and Pull Request: Two Lanes, Seven Steps
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A two-lane diagram of the seven steps for improving a resource you do not own: find it, fork it, change your copy, propose the change, review, respond, and merge.

educational.topic: The fork and pull request workflow for improving someone else's resource
learningObjectives: The learner will order the seven steps of the fork and pull request workflow and say in which copy each step happens.
prerequisites: The meaning of a repository, a fork, and a pull request from [Chapter 4](../../chapters/04-open-formats-version-control/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Whose copy is this step in?
commonMisconceptions: You edit the original repository directly
A pull request is sent before the change is made
The maintainer must accept every pull request
assessmentOpportunities: Where do you make your change?
Can a pull request be sent before the change is made?
Must the maintainer accept every pull request?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
